details:
Project Details – Circadian Shield

Circadian Shield is an integrated astronaut health-monitoring system designed to address circadian rhythm disruption during space missions, particularly aboard the International Space Station (ISS), where astronauts experience approximately 16 sunrises and sunsets every 24 hours.

The project combines two main components: a smart wearable watch and an AI-powered website. The wearable is designed to collect physiological and behavioral data, including heart rate, sleep patterns, physical activity, and environmental light exposure. This data is then analyzed through the website, which provides visual health insights, estimates circadian rhythm alignment, identifies potential sleep disruptions, and generates personalized recommendations. The platform also proposes smart lighting support to help astronauts maintain healthier rest schedules.

The main benefit of Circadian Shield is its proactive approach to astronaut well-being. Instead of simply recording sleep information, it connects environmental conditions with physiological and behavioral patterns to support better daily routines, sleep management, and health monitoring. Its intended impact extends beyond the ISS, with potential applications in future lunar and Mars missions, as well as on Earth for shift workers and individuals with irregular sleep schedules.

The proposed development uses web technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and potentially React, alongside Python-based data analysis and machine-learning tools. The hardware concept includes wearable sensors such as heart rate monitors, accelerometers, and ambient light sensors. Publicly available NASA research data and simulated datasets can support testing and demonstration.

What makes Circadian Shield creative is the integration of wearable technology, AI-driven analysis, and environmental support into one connected system. The team considered scientific relevance, technical feasibility, astronaut safety, data reliability, usability, and the limitations of developing technology for the space environment.

Ultimately, Circadian Shield aims to transform astronaut health monitoring into a more intelligent, personalized, and proactive system, supporting healthier human exploration beyond Earth.
